title: Trait Imports and Crate Visibility
goal: Understand pub(crate) and why traits must be imported.

sections.text: The `pub` modifier makes an item completely public to all external crates. Use `pub(crate)` to share an item across your crate while hiding it from external users.

sections.caption: `pub(crate)` limits access to the current crate.

sections.text: Visibility also interacts with traits. To call a trait method on a type, that trait must be imported into the current scope.

sections.caption: The trait must be imported to use its methods or bounds.

sections.text: Even if a struct and its trait implementation are public, calling a trait method without importing the trait produces error `E0599`.

explanation: Understand pub(crate) and why traits must be imported.
